title: GitHub Actions Feels Bad
summary: A fasterthanlime video essay arguing that GitHub Actions is a poorly designed system, with a history of personal computing and CI, and a look at how it works behind the scenes. It is sponsored by Brilliant.
why: Pointed to in GitHub Actions threads as a well-argued critique of how brittle and confused the platform is.

quote.text: This video really highlighted just how brittle the whole thing is even behind the scenes
